resources.string:
With your permission, we'll collect your height and weight to calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI). We'll then pair your BMI with the reaction-time results you already generate while training in this app, so we can study whether there's a correlation between BMI and reaction time.

• This is entirely optional — you can create an account and use the app without sharing this.
• Your height, weight, and BMI are visible to you in your Profile.
• You can turn this off at any time from your Profile; doing so deletes your stored height and weight.
• This data is linked to your account for accuracy, and used internally for reflex/fitness research — we won't share it outside the app.
Share my height & weight for this research (optional)
